flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper} (reminder query RD1-DR3, refreshContactInfo, validateContactInfo, combineNotices, sendBatchSms), schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, controllers/NotificationSmsEmailController, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, workflows/agencies/toppan/download/jobs/ToppanDownloadJob (stage DR3 -> CPC), cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-prod.properties. ocmsadminapi: notice_creation/core/helpers/NoticeProcessingHelper (UPL type X notices start at DN1). Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); the demo_remark about Vault and code split (Vault connection for the App Service) cannot verify from repo. This is the UPL-offender version of OCMS11.43; the same eNotification job (NotificationSmsEmailJob) handles all notice types. For notices whose last_processing_stage is DR3 (driver path; UPL type X notices are created with next stage DN1, NoticeProcessingHelper.java:404), the reminder query picks notices close to their due date and the job then prepares the contact. The mobile refresh from DataHive only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = true, but it is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the number stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver is used. The eNotification job itself is switched off in prod (cron.notification.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:236). Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-185 (22 Sep 2026) states that UPL processing logic has not been developed in OCMS and UPL notice stages are patched manually; whether UPL notices really reach DR3 through the automatic path cannot verify from repo. OCMS-DF-2026-180 (ENA, status Closed) still waits for the eNotification cron to be activated. The DOS source, Vault and the real server property values cannot verify from repo. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence.
recommendation: Claim partially. Reminder selection after the 3rd letter and contact validation exist, but the mobile refresh from DataHive is switched off in every environment (flag false) and the eNotification job is inactive in prod. OCMS-SR-2026-185 says UPL logic has not been developed. Ask URA to confirm the DOS source, the job activation date, and how UPL notices reach DR3.

steps.step: After the 3rd letter (DR3 on the driver path) is sent to the offender, OCMS selects the notices that need an electronic reminder
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder selects VON rows with last_processing_stage IN ('RD1','RD2','RR3','DN1','DN2','DR3') whose due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) is already inside the ENOTEDAYS window, offender_indicator = 'Y', not in the exclusion list, not yet sent a reminder for the same stage, and not suspended except TS-HST (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1162). The vehicle filter only drops types I, D, V (1151), so UPL notices (type X) are selected. UPL notices are created with next stage DN1 (NoticeProcessingHelper.java:404), so the 3rd letter for a UPL offender is DR3, and the stage moves DR3 -> CPC after a successful Toppan download (ToppanDownloadJob.java:409-410). The job copies the stage from last_processing_stage into the record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-180). Partial because: (1) the query INNER JOINs an ENOTEDAYS row per stage, and whether a DR3 row exists cannot verify from repo; (2) cron.notification.enabled=false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236; NotificationJobsScheduler.java:48-53), although the job can be triggered manually through POST /v1/notification-sms-email/execute (NotificationSmsEmailController.java:38-39); the real server value cannot verify from repo; (3) OCMS-SR-2026-185 states that UPL processing logic has not been developed and UPL notice stages are patched manually, so whether UPL notices reach DR3 through the automatic path cannot verify from repo. The query does not distinguish UPL from other notices; same as OCMS11.43.

steps.step: OCMS checks the offender's latest mobile number from the data source (Epic OCMS9) and updates it
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for every record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). refreshContactInfo only reaches DataHive when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true'; otherwise it uses the stored number and only normalises the individual's mobile (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2461-2478). The flag is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). The active path exists: refreshIndividualContactInfo reads the Singpass view in DataHive, rejects a contact shorter than 8 characters ('Invalid mobile format'), then writes the new number to ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver through updateOcmsContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2770, 2800-2823). The candidate query uses offender_indicator = 'Y' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1112), so the current offender is the one checked. The origin of the stored number for a UPL offender cannot verify from repo (the only writers of offender_tel_no visible in the repo are furnish and PLUS owner-driver). The story names DOS; DataHive = DOS cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: A notice with an empty or invalid mobile number is not sent a reminder
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with a contactError and individuals without a phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290). In the job, a failing record is left out of the SMS batch (for non-ENA stages it only logs 'Skipping record with invalid contact', NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:252-266). The check only confirms the number is not empty; the 8-character minimum is checked only in the DataHive path that is switched off. The job is inactive in prod, but the validation logic matches the story text; same verdict as OCMS11.43.

steps.step: The result of the check is used for an electronic reminder that refers to the 3rd letter reminder
steps.detail: For a reminder, the record's nextProcessingStage is filled with last_processing_stage (DR3), so determineTemplateName produces DR3_SMS_INDIVIDUAL (or DR3_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-180; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-476). The template data holds noticeNo, combinedNotices, amountPayable and a paymentDueDate computed from the letter date (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:410-437). The template text lives in ocms_template_store (DB) and is not seeded in the repo, so whether the wording refers to the 3rd letter cannot verify from repo; a missing template makes the SMS be skipped (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:274-312, 1563-1567). For a company at stage DR3 the email is skipped because there is no template (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-316). SMS delivery is assessed in OCMS13.17.
